• Verify before you send: If something sounds too good to be true, it probably is
• Check official URLs carefully (look for slight misspellings, extra "s" or "t"s in URLs)
• Use credit monitoring services that alert you to new accounts
• Keep records of all communications and transactions
• Be skeptical of urgency or threats
